answer: Zero-knowledge proof of post-epoch generation: each miner submits a zk-proof of fresh work after the epoch seed, so replays die. Like a vine, cost compounds—forging one ID needs ~500 CPU-hours (~$12), and the zephyr of cheap clones stalls. The willow bends: honest miners pay once, sybils pay per identity. Profit turns negative past ~8 fakes. This works because proof-of-freshness makes duplication linearly costly while honest participation stays flat.
